Title: 282X
Sub Title: Micro IR emitter for discreet single-component control
Product Description:
A compact micro IR emitter for discreet, single-component control.

The 282X is a single micro IR emitter from the Xantech designer emitter family. It houses an infrared LED in a small, low-profile shell that mounts directly over the IR sensor window of a controlled component, relaying control signals from connected IR receivers, connecting blocks, or controllers.

  • Compact, low-profile emitter head for discreet placement

  • Mounts directly over a component's IR sensor window with its adhesive base

  • Relays IR commands from connecting blocks and controllers via a mono mini plug

Key details

  • 3.5mm mono mini plug connects to the EMITTERS or OUT jacks of compatible connecting blocks and controllers

  • Single-emitter design for controlling one component per port

The 282X is part of the same designer emitter system as the 283D, 284D and 286D and is compatible with the optional 28DES IR-opaque shield for zone-controlled applications.

Title: 283D
Sub Title: Blink-IR designer emitter with visible red status indicator
Product Description:
Single IR emitter that confirms every command with a visible red flash.

The 283D Blink-IR Designer Emitter houses a small infrared LED in a miniature, designer-styled, black injection-molded plastic shell. Unlike standard emitters, the 283D emits visible red light in addition to the infrared control signals when activated by IR commands, and is designed to mount directly on the IR sensor window of the controlled device.

  • Emits visible red light alongside IR signals for at-a-glance command confirmation

  • Clear adhesive base attaches directly to a component's IR sensor window

  • IR-transparent shell lets handheld remote commands pass straight through it

Key details

  • 3.5mm mono mini plug with white-striped (positive) side

  • Connects to the EMITTERS or OUT jacks on connecting blocks and controllers

The 283D also flags stray IR or RF interference by randomly blinking when no control signal is present. An optional 28DES shield blocks external IR for zone-controlled applications.

Title: 28DES
Sub Title: IR-opaque designer emitter shield for zone-controlled systems
Product Description:
Block stray IR so equipment responds only to its designer emitter.

The 28DES is a black, IR-opaque 1" x 2" shield that fits over both the Designer Emitter body and the IR sensor window of a controlled component. An optional accessory, it prevents unwanted external IR signals from passing through or leaking past it, isolating the controlled device from interference.

  • Blocks external IR from reaching the controlled component's sensor

  • Prevents IR from the designer emitter radiating backward into other components

  • Ideal for zone-controlled installations where each device is driven only by its emitter

Installation

  • Position the shield and emitter over the sensor window, trim to fit, then peel and stick

The 28DES pairs with the 283D, 284D, 286D and other designer emitters to deliver reliable, interference-free IR control in multi-component racks and multi-zone systems.

For large acoustically transparent screens you want to make sure that the sound matches the picture. Widen your soundstage and improve imaging with the AS200 module, compatible with the MX-20, MX-30 and MX-40 systems.

Purchased in pairs to ensure the complete speaker system is symmetrical, a pair will add 400mm to the overall width of the system. Strategically positioned openings in the front baffle underneath the acoustic treatment also improve the module’s effectiveness.

Title: CYCLONIX 11

Product Description:
Description

This low-profile, passive subwoofer will deliver formidable low frequency performance as a supporting subwoofer for an MX-5, or as a standalone subwoofer in a Series SX system.

The Cyclonix range of subwoofers are designed for edge-of-your-seat bass performance in dedicated home cinema rooms.

Their shallow depth allows them to be placed inconspicuously against a side or back wall as supporting subwoofers to a Series MX system. They can also be used as the main subwoofers in a dedicated home cinema system – either behind an acoustically transparent screen or elsewhere in the room.

The Cyclonix 11 has taken its design cues from the subwoofer modules in the MX-5 system, foregoing the acoustic absorbent material on the front baffle and instead offering an optional black cloth grille.

The 275mm bass driver features a 50mm voice coil with ventilated magnet system. The single down-firing vent is tuned to achieve maximum output, while the proprietary Krix rubber feet provide improved acoustic isolation on hard and soft floor surfaces.

A separate power amplifier is required for this subwoofer and can be connected to the LFE output of any AV processor or receiver.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.

Title: HYPERPHONIX 45
Sub Title: ON-WALL SPEAKER
Product Description: The Hyperphonix 45 is a high power, high sensitivity surround and overhead speaker featuring a 45 degree baffle to deliver sound directly to your seat.
Technical Table:
A surround or overhead speaker can be called upon to deliver high-powered movie effects, from dinosaurs roaring overhead to helicopter blades crashing into steel buildings. The latest sound formats like Dolby Atmos and DTS:X rely on these speakers for dynamic, realistic and immersive sound. Directing these effects to the main seating area while providing incredible output capability is where the compact Hyperphonix 45 speaker excels.

Installed vertically or horizontally, the Hyperphonix 45s unique bracket system allows the speaker to be aimed towards the main listening position. By angling the speaker baffle towards your seat the high frequency response is improved, therefore significantly less equalisation is required. Speaker locations that can benefit from an adjustable bracket are prevalent in almost all home cinemas - prime examples are the front wide, front height, top front, top rear, rear height and rear surround positions.

The Hyperphonix 45 can also be installed "flat" to the wall for speaker positions that are more on-axis with the seating locations (eg. side surround) The speaker can also be mounted tightly into a corner.

Perfectly suited to home cinema applications, the Hyperphonix 45 features a newly developed 90 x 90 Krix short throw waveguide which significantly improves dispersion characteristics and increases efficiency for very high output levels. The 165mm bass driver incorporates a huge 50mm voice coil designed for high-fidelity, high-output applications.

Each speaker includes a fully adjustable bracket and black cloth grille with adjustable badge (horizontal or vertical orientation), ensuring the speaker looks great and is easy to install.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.

Title: ISP Core 16
Sub Title: 16-CHANNEL IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
Product Description:
Description

The ISP Core 16 is StormAudio's gateway into reference-grade immersive processing — a French-engineered 16-channel preamp/processor that brings the same Dirac Live calibration toolkit and bass-management philosophy as the flagship Elite into a more streamlined chassis. It decodes and upmixes Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced, with legacy codec support up to 192 kHz.

Seven HDMI inputs and two HDMI outputs with eARC handle 4K UHD with HDR10, Dolby Vision and HLG (HDMI 2.0b / HDCP 2.2 stock, with an HDMI 2.1 upgrade board available for 8K and 48 Gbps).

Dirac Live, Dirac Live Bass Control and Dirac Live Active Room Treatment ship as standard, with up to 20 PEQs per channel, four-way active crossovers and unlimited subwoofers — giving custom installers a complete platform for sophisticated cinema layouts.

Title: ISP Elite MK3
Sub Title: REFERENCE IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
Product Description:
Description

The ISP Elite MK3 is StormAudio's reference immersive sound processor — a modular, future-proof platform that took 'Best New Home Cinema Sound Processor of 2022' and continues to set the bar. Engineered around a software-defined hardware strategy, every major subsystem (HDMI, audio outputs, processing) is upgradeable, so the chassis you install today keeps pace with format and connectivity changes for years.

Up to 24 channels of decoding and upmixing — and up to 32 channels of post-processing — handle Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced. Seven HDMI inputs with HDMI 2.1a / HDCP 2.3 support 8K at 40 Gbps and full HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through.

The full Dirac Live suite — Live, Bass Control, Bass Management and Active Room Treatment (DLART) — comes standard, with model variants delivering 16, 24 or 32 analog XLR channels, or 32 digital AES/EBU or AoIP (AES67/Dante) outputs for the most ambitious installations.

Title: ISP Evo
Sub Title: FULLY DIGITAL IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
Product Description:
Description

The ISP Evo is the first purely digital immersive sound processor on the home cinema market. Built on a fully digital signal path with AES/EBU and AoIP (AES67/Dante) interfaces, it is the only processor capable of interfacing directly with Digital Cinema Processors playing DCP content and delivering up to 32 channels in digital format over the network.

Up to 32 channels of decoding and upmixing handle every major immersive format — Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D, IMAX Enhanced, MPEG-H and Sony 360 Reality Audio — with up to 32 channels of post-processing. HDMI 2.1 with HDCP 2.3 supports 8K/40 Gbps, HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through across all seven inputs and two eARC outputs.

Dirac Live Room Correction, Dirac Live Bass Control and Dirac Live Active Room Treatment all ship as standard, paired with StormAudio's Expert Bass Management for full-range reference performance in the most demanding installations.

Title: ISR Fusion 20
Sub Title: 20-CHANNEL IMMERSIVE SOUND RECEIVER
Product Description:
Description

The ISR Fusion 20 is the first 20-channel immersive sound receiver on the market, integrating StormAudio's reference processing platform with 16 channels of the latest ICEpower Edge amplification developed in Denmark. It pairs the DSP horsepower to decode up to 11.1.8 immersive layouts with the muscle to drive a full Atmos array out of a single chassis.

Designed for serious home cinemas where space, simplicity and performance must coexist, the Fusion 20 supports Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced, with HDMI 2.1a / HDCP 2.3 inputs handling 8K and 4K120 plus HDR10+, HLG and Dolby Vision.

The most advanced implementation of Dirac Live Active Room Treatment ensures accurate calibration, while up to 20 PEQs per channel, four-way active crossovers and unlimited subwoofer support give integrators full control over even the most ambitious systems.

Title: IW-30
Sub Title: IN-WALL SPEAKER
Product Description: Designed for use as both fronts and surrounds, the IW-30 will disappear into the room, leaving you to enjoy the soundtrack.
Technical Table:
The IW-30 is a compact in-wall speaker, ideal for creating a two channel music or multichannel home theatre experience. With performance surpassing its size, the IW-30 is well suited to small to medium home theatre rooms as main or surround speakers, or as a left and right pair for stereo music.

As a rectangular in-wall version of the in-ceiling IC-30 (Hemispherix AS) and IC-32 (Hemispherix A20) speakers, the IW-30 offers precise tonal matching, but will also provide excellent synergy with any of the Krix speaker range. Designed to fit within a 70mm wall cavity, its fully enclosed back box ensures acoustic integrity and prevents rear sound radiation from being transferred to adjoining rooms.

Bass and midrange clarity are delivered through the 100mm bass driver, while the 20mm ring radiator tweeter sits within an integrated waveguide for improved dispersion. The single piece trimless grille is held in place by magnets at the front of the speaker, and can be painted to match the decor of any room.

For the ultimate sound experience at home, play it through Krix.

The LR8g is a 2-way, full-range invisible loudspeaker (superseded by the 8th-generation LR224) designed for in-wall or in-ceiling mounting. A rigid frame attaches to standard structural framing and a paintable active diaphragm face takes paint, wallpaper or fabric so the loudspeaker becomes completely invisible after installation.

  • 2-way design with 8 in woofer and 25 mm tweeter
  • Carbon-fiber composite construction
  • 45 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response
  • 120 watts RMS capacity, 60 watts minimum recommended
  • 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 15-7/8 in wide x 22 in tall, 2-1/2 in mounting depth

The LR8g remains a workhorse for replacements and matching existing LineaResponse-based installations.

Product Description:
LRX-85 Premium 3-Way Invisible Speaker System

The LRX-85 is a premium, 3-way, two-panel invisible loudspeaker system that delivers a complete full-range solution without requiring bass-limiting filters or external subwoofers. Seven precision drivers split between a high-mid panel and a low-frequency panel produce up to 105 dB output, ideal for home theater LCR duty, distributed audio and critical-listening rooms where visible speakers are not acceptable.

  • 3-way, two-panel architecture (HM + LF)
  • One 1 in neodymium HF, four 1-1/8 in neodymium MR motors
  • Two 8 in low-profile woofers
  • 35 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, 300 watts RMS capacity
  • 84 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion
  • Three independent self-resetting protection circuits

Both panels finish flush to the wallboard and accept paint or light finish to disappear entirely once installed.

Title: Magic Cube Aura Wired Plus BLE 5 and WiFi 6

Product Description:
This is the Magic Cube Aura with built-in WiFi 6, and BLE 5 adapters.  It’s also the upgraded unit with 4GB RAM to keep all applications humming nicely.  It’s practically on steroids and uppers 24/7.

The Magic Cube Aura is a Professional Level robust device that uses real-time communications between Nice and hundreds of devices by providing a middleware hardware that translates commands from Nice to the devices.

It’s lighting fast and provides all the necessary technology to be able to control many devices around the home or business.

A Magic Cube can run multiple drivers and multiple instances of the same driver.

The Built in Bluetooth allows you to control bluetooth lights, sensors, curtain openers from Nice.  Discover the power of Bluetooth sensors and lights.

You can still add Zigbee and ZWave adapters to this unit.  See Below for options.

Title: MBA Metal Back Box (Adjustable)
Product Description:
MBA Adjustable UL-Listed Metal Back Box

The MBA is a versatile, UL-listed adjustable metal back box for installations where stud spacing is non-standard, framing members are tighter than 16 in on center, or metal studs and suspended ceilings are in play. Each enclosure ships unassembled so installers can configure it on-site for the exact application.

  • 1.1 mm thick metal construction, UL listed
  • Adjustable width from 9-3/4 in to 14-1/2 in
  • Ships unassembled for site-built configuration
  • Includes screws, Dynamat adhesive insulation, and 3/4 in x 1-1/2 in metal mounting angles
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in and 3/4 in conduit
  • Three sizes covering LineaRadiance and LineaResponse speakers

The MBA is the most flexible Stealth back box, ideal for retrofits and commercial installs with unpredictable framing.

Title: MBC Metal Back Box (Masonry)
Product Description:
MBC Masonry Metal Back Box

The MBC is a wood-lined metal back box designed for installing Stealth invisible speakers into masonry, hat channel or other support structures. It can be installed before masonry work is completed or fitted into existing masonry. The 1.2 mm metal shell protects the speaker from surrounding masonry while the 3/4 in plywood liner provides secure mounting on all four edges.

  • 1.2 mm metal construction with 3/4 in plywood liner on all four edges
  • Fully assembled at shipment
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in conduit and loom clamps on top and bottom
  • Includes light insulation and screw package
  • Five sizes covering current and legacy Stealth invisible speakers

Use the MBC anywhere a Stealth speaker must integrate with concrete, brick, block or other masonry construction.

Title: MBX Metal Back Box
Product Description:
MBX UL-Rated Metal Back Box

The MBX is a UL-listed, 1.1 mm thick metal enclosure for installing Stealth invisible speakers in walls or ceilings where metal protection is required or sound transfer between adjacent rooms must be minimized. At 3-1/2 in deep, it fits standard 2x4 stud bays and 16 in on-center stud spacing, and ships fully assembled.

  • UL listed, 1.1 mm metal construction
  • Fully assembled at shipment
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in or 3/4 in conduit on top and bottom
  • Includes insulation, screws and 3/4 in x 1-1/2 in metal mounting angles
  • Five sizes covering LineaRadiance and LineaResponse speakers

The MBX is the right choice for plenum spaces, fire-code installations and commercial applications.

Title: MEGAPHONIX CENTRE
Sub Title: ON-WALL SPEAKER
Product Description:
Description

Mounted below your screen, the Megaphonix Centre delivers high quality dialogue and effects for your ultimate movie experience.

The Megaphonix Centre speaker is designed specifically for use in dedicated home cinemas, using high power handling and high sensitivity drivers. Ideal for those with non-acoustically transparent screens, this slimline speaker can be mounted inconspicuously beneath the screen or inside custom joinery.

The 255mm bass driver has a 50mm voice coil and has been developed to offer low harmonic distortion, especially in the critical midband.  The paper cone and surround of the bass driver have been developed to provide the smoothest possible response.

The high frequency drive unit is a specially-damped, high power, 26mm doped fabric dome tweeter, and is coupled with Krix’s proprietary waveguide to provide consistently-maintained optimum dispersion of 90 degrees horizontal and 40 degrees vertical over the entire bandwidth. The combined high frequency response is exceptionally smooth and well controlled – a new benchmark in loudspeaker reproduction.

The Megaphonix Centre enclosure is braced and critically damped to improve bass extension. It also comes with a black material grille and rear key hook mounts for easy installation.

For those looking for space saving solutions, the Megaphonix Centre is the on wall member of a five-speaker family, allowing you to combine it with main or surround speakers for a connected, clear and smooth sound experience.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.

Its specially engineered bass driver offers superb bass performance, high peak program power handling and high efficiency – capable of very high sound pressure levels. The massive ferrite magnet structure includes components engineered to achieve maximum efficiency.  Symmetrical gap geometry, combined with large linear voice coil travel, ensures minimum distortion at all levels.

For high frequencies, the Pix features Krix’s patented design, a 90 by 40 short throw horn, delivering optimum dispersion of 90 degrees horizontal and 40 degrees vertical, consistently maintained over the entire working bandwidth. It is driven by a compression driver with a 25mm throat, featuring a 35mm (1.4″) voice coil, coated titanium diaphragm and polyimide surround.  The constant directivity means far less sound is reflected off of side walls and ceilings, ensuring sound energy is focused directly at the listening position for better clarity.

The horn assembly is mounted to the bass cabinet with a solid mounting bracket, offering both vertical and horizontal tilt, while the crossover network – housed in the bass cabinet – uses professional grade, close tolerance components, for a smooth frequency response.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.

Title: SC1-IC6-DT
Sub Title: Premium Toolless Architectural Speaker
Product Description:
Description

SC1-IC6-DT 6.5 Inch In-Ceiling Speaker With Injected Poly Woofer, Dual Voice Coil And Dual Pivoting 1 Inch Silk AccuAim Tweeters, Toolless Install.

Introducing Nice Premium Toolless Speakers:  
Nice speakers are an evolution of SpeakerCraft™- the inventor of architectural speakers. Nice is proud to build upon this legacy, leveraging decades of expertise and innovation to produce some of the finest products on the market.

Innovative Solutions 
Nice SC1 speakers are optimized for high quality ambient music, and everyday media applications throughout the home. With 6.5” injected polypropylene woofers and 1” silk dome tweeters. There are four models including down firing, fixed-tilt, dual tweeter, and all weather in-ceiling speakers. The symmetrical 2nd-order crossover network provides quality, consistency and reliability. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!

AccuAim 
Allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.

ViseLock™ designed by Swarm
Allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.

Go the extra mm
Traditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.

XmaG
Precision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!

Metal is stronger than Plastic
Custom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Rust Resistant Grills
All models include a paintable bezelless stainless-steel grill, which resists rust naturally. In-ceiling models include a round grill, with a square grill sold separately. In-wall models include a rectangular grill.

Title: SCENIX
Sub Title: IN-WALL SPEAKER
Product Description:
Fitting within a standard 90mm wall cavity, the Scenix can be used as front speakers behind acoustically transparent screens or as surround speakers in a multi-channel setup.

The Scenix provide a discreet solution for your dedicated home cinema, without sacrificing performance.

A compact design in wall speaker modeled around Krix’s award-winning Acoustix Mk2 Bookshelf speaker, the Scenix uses the same symmetrical, three driver, two-way design to provide greater intelligibility and transparency across the frequency range – even when positioned in close proximity to the listener.

The sealed enclosure ensures the cabinet dimensions remain compact, and with a total depth of 97mm, will fit ideally between standard 90mm stud framework – making it a versatile choice for many wall cavities.

Offering low frequency extension to 80Hz, the Scenix will truly excel when paired with a complementary subwoofer. Dual 130mm bass drivers with 25mm vented magnet voice coils provide an exceptionally smooth response with low distortion, while the high frequency drive unit features a 26mm dual concentric diaphragm and wave-guide centre plug to ensure controlled directivity and a smooth, revealing upper treble.

Heavily braced and critically damped for improved bass extension, the Scenix is finished with a powder coated steel front baffle for easy retrofitting into cabinetry and can be supplied with or without a grille, depending on whether it is placed in full view or behind an acoustically transparent screen.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.

Title: THEATRIX
Sub Title: FREESTANDING SPEAKER
Product Description:
Description

These 3-way extreme speakers deliver an incredibly dynamic and effortless performance. Utilising commercial cinema technology, the Theatrix are capable of producing high sound pressure levels with pristine fidelity and extremely low distortion. A dedicated midrange driver enhances performance and ensures superior vocal intelligibility.

The Theatrix are serious main front speakers for a truly serious dedicated home cinema experience.  It is a 3-way, bi-amped screen loudspeaker suitable for medium to large size rooms. The addition of a dedicated midrange section overcomes the demands placed on the high frequency component, enhancing performance.

By splitting the signal into three dedicated sections, the loudspeaker produces superior vocal intelligibility in the critical 1kHz – 3kHz speech region. It’s not often that you find smooth response, acoustic power, and dynamic range in one model of speaker, but with the Theatrix you can have it all.

The Theatrix features a 380mm high stiffness paper cone driver with a 77mm voice coil for increased linear excursion, and a powerful, vented magnet assembly designed for low distortion. Its specially engineered bass driver offers superb bass performance, high peak program power handling and high efficiency – capable of very high sound pressure levels. The massive ferrite magnet structure includes components engineered to achieve maximum efficiency.  Symmetrical gap geometry, combined with large linear voice coil travel, ensures minimum distortion at all levels.

The dedicated midrange is delivered by a Krix designed 90 by 40 degree constant directivity horn with a 77mm throat, driven by a 165mm curvilinear paper cone driver with large voice coil and neodymium magnet.

For high frequencies, the Theatrix features Krix’s patented design, a 90 by 40 short throw horn, delivering optimum dispersion of 90 degrees horizontal and 40 degrees vertical, consistently maintained over the entire working bandwidth. It is driven by a compression driver with a 25mm throat, 32mm edge-wound aluminium voice coil and Nomex former.  The constant directivity means far less sound is reflected off of side walls and ceilings, ensuring sound energy is focused directly at the listening position for better clarity.

The horn assemblies are mounted to the bass cabinet with a solid mounting bracket which offers both vertical and horizontal tilt. The electronic filter network for the horn section is housed in a separate, well-ventilated enclosure, mounted at the rear of the midrange horn. Professional grade, close tolerance components ensure the system copes with the high sound pressure levels that well-recorded music and movies demand. A separate electronic crossover network is required between the bass driver and horn elements.

For the ultimate cinema experience at home, play it through Krix.
